status: shadow versions: recorded and evaluated in parallel with forward-rule-v1, which they do not change; parameters frozen; any change requires a new version; versions are only ever added, each with its own registeredAt

versions.name: V1-四分之一
versions.definition: forward-rule-v1 L2, and the T-10 line is a quarter line (|line| mod 1 is 0.25 or 0.75), i.e. the rule team is the .25 receiving team or the .75 giving team
versions.origin: research/README.md section on further improvements; proposed after the 10-09..10-12 review

versions.name: V1-多阶段
versions.definition: rule team on a quarter line; G_LINE; at least two of V1 at T-120, T-60 and T-30 point to the rule team; none of V1 at T-120, T-60, T-30 and T-10 points to the other team
versions.stageTeam: each stage uses its own cutoff (kickoff minus the stage lead) and its own line: D > 50 is the giving team at that line, D < 50 the other team; neutral or unavailable counts as no direction
versions.origin: research/improve.py multi-stage vote, selected while exploring

versions.name: L0-水位门
versions.definition: forward-rule-v1 L0 (every rule decision) that passes G_HOLD

versions.name: 水位门否决
versions.definition: the L0 decisions G_HOLD vetoes (rule team against the held team); recorded to check that the vetoed side keeps losing

evaluation.decisionsCounted: non-late decisions with kickoff at or after prospectiveFrom; the same frozen T-10 quote and settlement as forward-rule-v1
evaluation.comparison: each shadow against forward-rule-v1 L2 and L0 on the same decisions (same period)
evaluation.winRate: (win + half_win) / (win + half_win + half_loss + loss); push excluded

historicalReference: forward_rule.py backtest writes backtest-shadows.json; see RULES.md

G_HOLD.name: G_HOLD 水位压盘门
G_HOLD.definition: over every valid prematch Royal quote up to the T-10 cutoff the line never changed, and the upper side's (giving team, home on a level line) T-10 water is <= upperLowWaterMax (market keeps favouring the upper side by water alone) or >= upperHighWaterMin (it keeps favouring the lower side); that side is the held team. The gate fails when the rule team is the other team; it passes when there is no held team.
G_HOLD.evidence: supremacy research 2026-10-13, all deduped Royal T-10 matches: upper low water with the line never changed -> upper win rate 55.6% dev / 57.3% holdout, backing the lower side ROI -11.8% / -13.5%; upper high water with the line never changed -> upper 40.1% / 39.9%, backing the upper side ROI -10.4% / -10.5%. Thresholds were picked after seeing both windows, so only the prospective record counts as evidence.
G_HOLD.scope: G_HOLD can only fire on matches whose line never changed, so it never removes an L2, V1-四分之一 or V1-多阶段 bet (all require the line to have moved toward the rule team); it acts on L0 and L1
